description: Wavi evaluation dataset. Synthetic users, records, policies and organizations only (see WaviEvaluationWorld). Expectations come from the product requirements. route: LOOKUP (answered from the user's own authorized records), FIXED (deterministic Waypoint answer, no lookup, no model), POLICY (company-policy pipeline: grounded, unverified, not-found or unavailable), AI (a general model answer without policy text), OUT_OF_SCOPE (scope refusal), ERROR. roles default to EMPLOYEE, HR and COMPANY_ADMIN; byRole overrides individual keys of expect.
